calls.title: Insta Veritas & GrowthBook
calls.summary: Amit Kumar Kesharwani's team discussed implementing A/B testing on their Verify product website to understand customer behavior and improve conversion rates, which currently stands at around 10% for approximately 10,000 monthly visitors. This leads to an estimated $26,000 in monthly revenue from about 1,000 paying customers. James Shannon highlighted the potential for a single effective experiment to increase conversion rates to 15%, possibly adding $13,000 in revenue per month. GrowthBook's SDK integration into their existing technical stack was emphasized as crucial for experimentation and data collection. Pricing options were reviewed, including a free tier for up to 3 users and a professional tier at $40 per user. The need for the CTO's involvement in budget approvals and upcoming demos was also discussed.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, GrowthBook Architecture, Feature Flags, Experimentation, Conversion Funnel, SDK Integration
